summary: Iteration 15: Frontend Google Callback Route Verified. All 10 backend tests passed (100%). The new frontend route /auth/google-callback now exists and renders the GoogleCallbackScreen component correctly. When accessed with an invalid session_id, it shows a proper error state with 'Google auth failed' message and 'Back to login' button. Backend compatibility page at /api/auth/google-callback still returns HTML. Login and welcome pages load correctly.
